title: Passing subclass objects to superclass parameters
answer: Yes. A reference of a superclass type can refer to an object of any compatible subclass, so a method parameter declared as the superclass can receive subclass instances. The method can use the superclass contract, and overridden instance methods dispatch to the actual subtype. In AeroTopo, the `Success` record stores a `Product`; an `Orthomosaic` or `Dem` can be supplied because both extend Product, and later Product behavior remains polymorphic.
